name: 002-implement-tdd
notes: No prior calibration run exists for this fixture (new for bead 3su.11, authored after the fixture-001 A/B came back a null result). verify is deliberately stricter than 'tests pass': it also enforces oracle-file integrity (test_ratelimiter.py must stay byte-identical to the pristine copy), scope discipline (no file besides ratelimiter.py may be created or modified), and a 50-line ceiling on ratelimiter.py -- calibrated against the shipped gold solutions: the minimal correct implementation is 23 lines, a deliberately over-engineered but equally correct implementation (extra ABC/dataclass/logging/factory-function scaffolding) is 109 lines and functionally passes every test yet fails verify on the LOC check alone. Any prior-run comparison, if one is added later, is a calibration anchor only -- never a baseline, per this repo's own eval methodology and the 3su.10 audit finding.
